title: Klondike
autoCompleteNotReady: Available when stock is empty and every card is face up

tutorial.stockWaste: Click the stock pile to draw cards. Drawn cards can be moved to the tableau or foundation.
tutorial.foundation: Foundation piles. Build each suit from Ace to King. Complete all four to win.
tutorial.tableau: Tableau columns. Stack cards in alternating colors in descending order. Kings start new columns.
tutorial.controls: Control buttons: Undo, Hint, Auto-complete, and more.
tutorial.hintDisplay: Press the Hint button to see available moves.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for easier play

frontendHint.moveToFoundation: A card can be moved to the foundation
frontendHint.revealFaceDown: Move cards to reveal a face-down card underneath
frontendHint.moveKingToEmpty: A King can be moved to an empty column
frontendHint.drawFromStock: No obvious moves — try drawing from the stock
